617:t_127:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I am a $$次元将$$! I will keep fighting until my life ends!!」

617:t_128:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_128:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I fight to protect the possibilities of the world... of people...」

617:t_128:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「And I fight to fulfill my promise to $$オードリー$$!」

617:t_128:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I can understand the first reason, but not the second.」

617:t_128:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I can't understand you either! You dragged this world into war!」

617:t_128:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「If we cannot understand each other...」

617:t_128:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why can't you see how meaningless it is to settle things through force like that?!」

617:t_128:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「The universe demands power! Species that cannot accept that will only perish!」

617:t_128:8.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so! I reject a world like that!!」

617:t_129:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_129:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「I open the way to the future...! That is my fight!」

617:t_129:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You mean as a forerunner?」

617:t_129:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「Being an $$イノベイター$$ has nothing to do with it! I fight as one human living in this world... as a human who wishes for peace!」

617:t_129:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$次元将ヴィルダーク#pilot$$! Humanity will surpass you!」

617:t_129:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Offer me that power, that will, that resolve! Neither you nor humanity will go any farther!」

617:t_130:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_130:1.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll end war! That's what I fight for!」

617:t_130:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「It is meaningless. Species evolve through conflict.」

617:t_130:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Just as I will gain new power by defeating you!」

617:t_130:4.en:
$$シン$$
「Don't drag this world into your selfish reasoning!」

617:t_130:5.en:
$$シン$$
「If you want to fight that badly, I'll take you on! And I'll finish you here!」

617:t_131:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_131:1.en:
$$キラ$$
「I fight for everyone...! That's why I fight!」

617:t_131:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「An abstract answer like that is not what I want to hear.」

617:t_131:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「What comes after that is for each person to decide! I'll protect this world's freedom so they can!」

617:t_131:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That resolve... Is it genuine?」

617:t_131:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Only by defeating such warriors can I ascend to greater heights!」

617:t_131:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「I have no intention of playing along with your battle!」

617:t_131:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「I'll end the fighting here! Bringing together the feelings and power entrusted to me!」

617:t_132:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_132:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Once, I would have answered that I fought to atone.」

617:t_132:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「But now, it's different! I, too, will fight for everyone on Earth and in space!」

617:t_132:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Has this man cast aside his doubts?!」

617:t_132:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That's the spirit! I acknowledge you as one of the strong!!」

617:t_133:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_133:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you want to know that badly, I'll tell you. I fight for peace.」

617:t_133:4.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That's an ordinary answer.」

617:t_133:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「You cannot even understand the worth of that ordinary thing... That's the kind of man you are.」

617:t_133:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well, warrior. There is merit in your words.」

617:t_133:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But your wish cannot be granted! What the universe seeks is battle!」

617:t_133:8.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no intention of obeying that reasoning...!」

617:t_134:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_134:1.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「What point is there in asking that?」

617:t_134:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask to judge whether you are a warrior worthy to stand before me.」

617:t_134:3.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「You size up other people... You're an utterly unpleasant man.」

617:t_134:4.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「Then I'll answer! I fight to crush filthy power like yours!」

617:t_134:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Very well! Your spirit... and your resolve are genuine!」

617:t_135:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_135:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「I chose to fight to protect what matters to me!」

617:t_135:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You carry your feelings on those wings and fly through the skies of battle...!」

617:t_135:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Then I will break those wings and strike you down to the earth!」

617:t_135:4.en:
$$アルト$$
「Like hell you will! My wings are my soul!」

617:t_135:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「I won't let a man like you take my soul!」

617:t_136:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_136:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That power of life...! I will make it mine!!」

617:t_137:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_137:1.en:
$$レド$$
「On this planet, I learned what it really means to live!」

617:t_137:2.en:
$$レド$$
「Someone who takes that away...! That person is my enemy!」

617:t_137:3.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「That answer hardly reflects the mindset of a $$人類銀河同盟$$ member.」

617:t_137:4.en:
$$レド$$
「Before I'm a soldier, I'm a human...! A living being!」

617:t_137:5.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll fight anyone who takes that away! Together with my friends!」

617:t_137:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「You have gained truth and power...」

617:t_137:7.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「Surpassing that is what makes me a $$次元将$$! Human, show me your power!」

617:t_138:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_138:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「Can you really afford to ask that?」

617:t_138:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I don't know what's behind it all, but you've been cornered and killed your own subordinates! You're a dictator on the brink!」

617:t_138:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「I won't give you a chance to turn things around! I'll finish this here!」

617:t_138:5.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I understand what kind of man you are...」

617:t_138:6.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「But I won't let you have your way! I will shatter your fighting spirit and resolve...」

617:t_138:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「The time for talking ended long ago! You washed-up dictator!!」

617:t_139:0.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I ask you... What do you fight for?」

617:t_139:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I fight to protect... the future!」

617:t_139:2.en:
$$ヴィルダーク$$
「I can tell. You are the same as me.」
